name: MiseOS Master Roster Gallery
description: React + TypeScript + Vite gallery for the 75-card MiseOS Master Roster with departments, rarity tiers, search filters, and copy-ready solo commands.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for schema, card identity, command grammar, or customer-facing release changes.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for new filters, gallery layouts, and validated metadata exports.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for styling fixes, copy fixes, and non-breaking data corrections.

release.cadence: manual until GHCR runner and primary npm packages are published
release.currentStrategy: Keep as workspace app until Vite build passes in CI.
release.nextMilestone: Publish static GitHub Pages preview and package @mise-os/master-roster-gallery.

answers.what: A React + Vite gallery for the 75-card MiseOS Master Roster.
answers.does: Displays, validates, filters, and exports Master Roster cards with MiseOS solo commands.
answers.permissions: Read-only local data and local Vite dev server only.
answers.registry: Workspace app now; future npm package @mise-os/master-roster-gallery.
answers.changed: Added 75-card data, typed TS modules, React gallery components, validation/export scripts, and registry manifest.
answers.safe: Safe as a read-only gallery and data export layer; publishing requires review.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes. Agents can validate and export roster data without mutating repository state.
